tasks.title: Close HOME and Docker journeys with machine parity
tasks.goal: Reconcile actual runtime proof for both required delivery modes before declaring this phase complete.
steps: Execute the complete HOME two-tool/shared-dependency/version/config/recovery/GC journey and the Arch-based image/service/profile/replacement journey through supported services.
Compare library, CLI and MCP structured identities/effects/results under the same captured scenarios; record unsupported contexts separately from missing implemented interfaces.
Reconcile all M-15 positive/negative cases and retained artifact IDs; require actual Linux execution, four client launch profiles, local service grants and no-GitHub evidence.
positive_cases: Both HOME and Docker end states satisfy their independent acceptance inventories.
Machine surfaces agree on generation, effect and evidence identities.
negative_cases: HOME-only or image-only completion closes the whole phase.

tasks.title: Document portable operation and recovery contracts
tasks.goal: Leave permanent developer/user documentation for self-hosted delivery, recovery and the precise future system boundary.
steps: Write proposed permanent documentation directories with executable examples taken from now-tested product grammar and local fixture outcomes, not invented commands.
Document independent registry/source/cache/OCI setup, exact input preparation, HOME lifecycle, image evidence/secret handling and retained minimal recovery/self-update path.
Describe future kernel/initramfs/bootloader/accounts/mounts/services interfaces and VMware boot/reboot/interrupted-upgrade/rescue acceptance without claiming or implementing a full distro.
positive_cases: A reader can reproduce the local/self-hosted delivery path from permanent docs.
Recovery reads manifest/lock/inventory when normal profile activation fails.
negative_cases: Permanent documentation depends on campaign task files or personal context paths.
Container tests are cited as proof of kernel/boot correctness.
checks: CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
TO CREATE: documentation example conformance cases using implemented operation grammar; coordinator supplies final reference/promotion checks.
acceptance: Documentation and capability matrix describe observed support and exact remaining VM/system limits.
No mandatory GitHub, Nix runtime, permanent daemon or model subscription is introduced.
tasks.safe_stop: Permanent docs are reviewable and all supporting evidence is outside disposable campaign material.
